resources.name: Hadith collections + Japanese selection
resources.description: 36,512 hadiths — Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Muwatta Malik and the three forty-hadith collections (vocalised Arabic, English, multi-scholar gradings) plus 281 hadiths with Japanese translations and explanations from HadeethEnc.com. Includes the corpus word index (tap-to-define root candidates + narrator-name statistics). Includes fuKhushu's derived study layer: chain/text boundaries, Qur'an verse quotations, related narrations across the collections, the hadith-of-the-day pool and a cross-book theme map. Built by fuKhushu scripts/build_hadith_db.py.
resources.attribution: Hadith text, translations and gradings compiled from fawazahmed0/hadith-api (Unlicense), which credits sunnah.com and the per-edition translators in its References.md. Japanese selection from the Encyclopedia of Translated Prophetic Hadiths, HadeethEnc.com (Rowad Translation Center), reproduced verbatim under its published terms — HadeethEnc API snapshot 2026-08-03. Derived links by fuKhushu; verse quotations found against the Tanzil Project's Qur'an text (tanzil.net).
